upload.title: Red Cards Didn't Always Exist 🟥 #shorts
upload.description:
Red and yellow cards didn't always exist in football. Referee Ken Aston got the idea while stopped at a traffic light.

#football #soccer #footballfacts #didyouknow #shorts
